h.O \"Google Meu Negócio\" hoje se chama G: What used to be "Google My Business" is now called Google Business Profile, but the effect is the same: it's the shop window that appears when someone searches for something in your line of business in your area. Whoever shows up in the top three spots on Maps captures the vast majority of clicks. Whoever is in 7th... gets almost nobody.
h.Direto do próprio Google: relevância, di: Straight from Google itself: relevance, distance and prominence. Each one weighs differently depending on the search, but they all count.
h.A categoria principal e categorias secun: The primary and secondary categories you selected in your Profile.
h.Os textos das suas avaliações (sim — pal: The text of your reviews (yes — words customers use in reviews feed into the ranking).
h.Endereço completo e correto no perfil —: A complete, correct address on your profile — without it, Google doesn't know your service radius.
h.Áreas de atendimento configuradas (se vo: Service areas set up (if you go to the customer, set up every neighborhood you serve).
h.Pin no Maps na localização exata — pin n: Your Maps pin at the exact location — a pin in the wrong place costs you positions.
h.Quantidade de avaliações. Mais avaliaçõe: Number of reviews. More reviews = a stronger positive signal.
h.Recência. Avaliações dos últimos 30 dias: Recency. Reviews from the last 30 days weigh more than ones from 2 years ago.
h.Diversidade nos textos. Reviews variadas: Variety in the text. Varied (not copied) reviews signal authenticity.
h.Respostas do dono. Perfis ativos rankeia: Owner replies. Active profiles rank better than abandoned ones.
h.Menções fora do Google. Notícias, blogs,: Mentions outside Google. News, blogs, local lists — the general "buzz".
h.O insight prático: dos três sinais, \"de: The practical insight: of the three signals, "prominence" offers the most leverage and depends most on you. And within "prominence", reviews are the biggest component.
h.Suba fotos novas todo mês — sinaliza que: Upload new photos every month — it signals the business is alive.
h.Com o básico arrumado, o que move o rank: With the basics in place, what moves the ranking is keeping the profile alive. Four things, every week:
h.Tem que entrar avaliação nova toda seman: New reviews have to come in every week — ideally several. You can't rely on spontaneous ones (which tend to be few and skewed negative). You need a system for asking. See the complete guide on how to get more reviews.
h.Foto de algo que você fez essa semana —: A photo of something you did this week — a beautiful dish, a happy customer (with permission), the team. It doesn't need to be a work of art; it needs to be recent.
h.Mês 1: você arruma o básico, começa a en: Month 1: you fix the basics, new reviews start coming in. The ranking doesn't move much yet.
h.Mês 2-3: volume de avaliações novas cria: Months 2-3: the volume of new reviews creates a pattern. You start showing up in searches where you didn't before.
h.Mês 3-6: seu perfil entra no \"top 3 loc: Months 3-6: your profile enters the "local top 3" for the main searches in your category + area. Traffic takes off.
h.Depois disso: efeito de reforço positivo: After that: a positive feedback loop — you show up more, get more customers, get more reviews, climb higher.
h.Quem só faz uma vez e abandona perde o g: Those who do it once and then stop lose the gains in 60-90 days. Local ranking is a race of maintenance, not of getting started.
h.Otimize o básico do perfil uma vez, depo: Optimize the profile basics once, then focus obsessively on keeping new reviews coming in every week — that's the highest-leverage signal and the only one you can feed consistently. NFC and QR technology at the point of contact exists precisely to solve this: cutting the friction of asking to almost zero, every day, without relying on outside marketing.
